provenance.registrations: Forty-three native TaskDesc records outside the card UI range, each independently corroborated by an exact ASCII name and unique tuple of all four real linked callback addresses in US/JP/EU. All records have equal work sizes in every region and are defined in the actual callback owner translation unit.
provenance.chara_mask_owner: The mask-fade callbacks in chara.c consume five variants of nine 32-byte frames, establishing the complete 1440-byte mask table. Its original high-ROM position directly precedes the two Chara task descriptors in every region, while both task names belong to a separate lower-ROM readonly run. Commit 34b9492b introduced the table const qualifier together with a recovery-only readonly section; the preceding declaration was mutable u8[]. This reconstruction assumes ordinary initialized byte storage, rather than observed mutation, so the unchanged mask and two descriptors form one native 1488-byte data section. All table bytes, object extents, names, code, relocations and RAM are preserved.
